# Fallout Day: Burning Springs coming on December 2nd, 2025 & Next Gen versions for Fallout 76

![Fallout Day: Burning Springs coming on December 2nd, 2025 & Next Gen versions for Fallout 76](/uploads/575_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In today's live Bethesda stream for Fallout Day there was some new information about the upcoming **Update "Burning Springs" with the next map expansion for Fallout 76**. When Burning Springs was announced, we were told the release would be "early December". This was confirmed today.

## Burning Springs release

The official Fallout 76 Burning Springs release date is **12/02/2025**.

![Fallout 76 Burning Springs Release Date](/uploads/falloutdaystream-2025-10-23-19-31-45.jpg)

## Next generation versions for Xbox and Playstation

And the long-awaited next generation versions for Xbox Series X / S and Playstation 5 are now on the way. Bethesda said the release date would be “early 2026”.

That's really not long away either. So we can be very excited to see how the revised versions will run on the Xbox Series X / S and the Playstation 5.

I play on Xbox Series X and PC myself and am looking forward to this new version.

## Fallout Day Stream

If you want to watch the Fallout Day stream again, you can find the recording of it here. In addition to Fallout 76, there was also a special edition for Fallout: New Vegas and a Fallout 4. And there are also some specials for Fallout: Shelter to celebrate Fallout's birthday.
